title: [Informações do servidor] Sistema de votação do líder da raça
bodyHtml:
original thread(ru) - *link*

Race leader voting system:
  • The list of candidates is formed by Contribution Points (CP);
  • The candidate's CP is fixed after registration;
  • Registration is available from Tuesday 00:01 to Friday 23:00 Moscow Time (Tuesday 21:00 to Friday 20:00 GMT)(Tuesday 04:01 to Saturday 03:00 WIB);
  • Voting takes place from Saturday 18:00 to Sunday 22:00 Moscow Time (Saturday 15:00 to Sunday 19:00 GMT)(Saturday 22:00 to Monday 02:00 WIB);
  • Race leader isn't automatically registered in next voting (need to manually register).

The first vote will be held on October 31st - November 1st


Requirements for the candidate

49+ level
Registration fee – 200.000.000 of racial currency


Voting requirements

48+ level


Power of the vote
  • level 48 - 5 points
  • level 49 - 10 points
  • level 50 - 15 points
  • Level 51 - 25 points
  • Level 52 - 35 points
  • Level 53 - 50 points
  • Level 54- 65 points
  • Level 55 - 85 points
  • Level 56 - 100 points
  • Level 57 - 120 points
  • Level 58 - 150 points
  • Level 59 - 170 points
  • level 60 - 200 points
  • Level 61 - 220 points
  • Level 62 - 240 points
  • Level 63 - 260 points
  • Level 64 - 280 points
  • Level 65 - 330 points
+CP according to the formula (number of CP/ 7000)
For example, the power of the vote of a level 53 character with 70,000 CP will result in 50 +10 (=60) vote points

Upon registration, the candidate loses 20% of the total amount of the CP
The voter loses 10% of the total amount of the CP
